messages.plaintextBody:
Nathan,

Witness statements are to be exchanged on 26 June. I've drafted your first statement covering the project background, the opening, the emergence of the defects and the financial impact. Could we have 45 minutes this week to go through it so you're comfortable signing? I'll send the current draft now.

Elena

Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
